user.title: Connect your apps
user.description: Enter a sync code (Settings → Sync & Backup in any app) to bring in everything in that setup, or one shared thing's code (👥 Share) to bring in just that. The code is kept in Home Assistant and used here to open your data; the apps' server never sees what's in it.

data_description.code: Letters and digits, with or without the dashes.

error.invalid_code: That code doesn't look right: check it and try again.
error.not_found: Nothing is saved under that code. Check that sync is switched on in the app.
error.refused: The apps' server isn't letting Home Assistant in yet. It needs its update first.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the apps' server. Is it running?

abort.already_configured: That code is already set up.

init.title: Apps in the sidebar
init.description: Pick the apps to show in Home Assistant's sidebar. They open as they do in a browser. This only works when Home Assistant is opened at its hedgepig.uk address.

abort.cannot_connect: Can't reach the apps' server to list the apps. Try again later.
